span.p:
UOP at goal, CK falling,
creatinine stable

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Oliguric, refractory hyperkalemia,
acidosis, volume overload

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(12, 58, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Suspected rhabdomyolysis:
myalgia, weakness, dark urine,
or a compatible trigger

div.style: color: rgb(12, 58, 82) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Send CK, BMP, calcium, phosphate,
bicarbonate, urinalysis, ECG

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Low risk: remove the trigger,
oral fluids, recheck CK in 24-48h

div.style: color: rgb(12, 58, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(124, 74, 3) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Admit. IV isotonic crystalloid:
LR or normal saline
1-2 L/hr initially

div.style: color: rgb(12, 58, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Continue, then taper fluids
as CK trends down

div.style: color: rgb(124, 74, 3) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ICU: renal replacement therapy
on standard AKI indications

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reassess the limb:
tense compartment or
delta pressure under 30 mmHg
equals urgent fasciotomy
